name: Foretell
author: MarshalX
description: A cast bar for every cast near you, soonest first, as a column or floating over each caster. Reads the world's cast state, so a silent boss mechanic still gets a bar, and charged casts count stages.

preview.alt: a borderless column of four draining cast bars, soonest to land first, each naming its caster underneath; a question mark marks a name worked out from the ability id.

keybinds.label: Show or hide the cast bars

settings.label: Where the cast bars are drawn
